rows.name: add-on FBX: two hinges, two panels, two trays, four frame markers
hierarchy: panel under its hinge; hinges, trays and markers on the add-on root (Unity re-parents hinges and trays under fus_rear and drops the markers)
rows.detail: airbrake_L_hinge <- GA25X_root, airbrake_R_hinge <- GA25X_root, airbrake_L <- airbrake_L_hinge, airbrake_R <- airbrake_R_hinge, airbrake_tray_L <- GA25X_root, airbrake_tray_R <- GA25X_root, airbrake_L_axis <- GA25X_root, airbrake_L_out <- GA25X_root, airbrake_R_axis <- GA25X_root, airbrake_R_out <- GA25X_root

rows.name: materials: panel [paint first, cockpit (dark inner face), structure (frames / stringers), metal_dark (seam, rim, hinge arms)], well [cockpit floor, structure stringers] without paint; UV layers livery + detail
triangles: each panel <= 2100, each well <= 560 (stock panels 120-474; ours follow the skin facets of the curved shoulder on the outer face, the inner face and every frame / stringer)

inner finish: the inner face is the dark `cockpit` finish over the whole panel (>= 93 % of the outer area: it lies 22 mm inside a convex skin); the light `structure` members, tops and side walls together, are 15-75 % of the panel area (about 30 % seen square-on); the well floor is dark, its light stringers <= 25 % of the floor
shut: a dark seam band 5-9 mm wide runs round the paint face on all four edges: hinge, aft, lower, upper (the closed panel reads as a panel)
shut: panel paint face 3-5 mm outside the fus_rear skin at every vertex and face centre (no poke-through)
paint texels: panel livery UV == UV of the skin point under each paint vertex (<= 0.5 texel of 4096); skin quads give the same UV on either diagonal within 1 texel (4.65 mm)
rows.detail: 1212 loop UVs, max 0.023 texel; 144 skin quads, diagonal difference max 0.212 texel; UV boxes {'L': [0.2738, 0.2249, 0.3296, 0.3085], 'R': [0.0283, 0.2249, 0.084, 0.3085]}

rows.name: hinge L: Unity X = hinge line (square to the long axis, tilted 57.13 deg over the shoulder, up-and-inboard on the left / the opposite on the right), Y = outward, Z = forward, right-handed; markers 1 m along X and Y; the curved front edge straddles the hinge line

hinge R: Unity X = hinge line (square to the long axis, tilted 57.13 deg over the shoulder, up-and-inboard on the left / the opposite on the right), Y = outward, Z = forward, right-handed; markers 1 m along X and Y; the curved front edge straddles the hinge line
stock Airbrake rotation (+55 deg about hinge-local X) moves the free edge away from the long axis by >= 0.2 m, left = right
rows.detail: outward {'L': 1.344, 'R': 1.344} m; free edge open at |x|, y, z (1.0584, -5.4401, 1.8746) (CG frame)

rows.name: well L: floor >= 1.5 mm above the skin, stringers >= 0.8 mm above the floor and >= 0.8 mm under the shut panel face
rows.detail: floor 2.00..2.00 mm, stringers 3.00..3.00 mm, panel face 4.9 mm

rows.name: well R: floor >= 1.5 mm above the skin, stringers >= 0.8 mm above the floor and >= 0.8 mm under the shut panel face
rows.detail: floor 2.00..2.00 mm, stringers 3.00..3.00 mm, panel face 4.9 mm

rows.name: open sweep 0..55 deg: the panels touch no other object of the model (flaps, stabiliser, fins, hatch, hook, turret, sensor pads)

open sweep: the curved front lip rides over the fixed skin ahead of the straight hinge line by at most 50 mm; fully open, the part of the panel still inside the fuselage (the middle of the front edge and the frames behind it) ends within 140 mm of the hinge line
rows.detail: ahead of the hinge line 44.2 mm; fully open: inside the fuselage up to 97 mm aft of the hinge line

rows.name: belly laser: whole panel above the laser at every opening angle; lowest sight line laser -> panel >= 10 deg above the laser horizon (turret limit -2 deg, beam +-1 deg); rays at +1 / -2 / -10 / -30 deg, every 2 deg of traverse, hit nothing
rows.detail: panel lowest z 0.544, laser axis z -1.483, muzzle z -1.483, lowest elevation 28.4 deg, 4320 rays, hits 0

rows.name: site: >= 0.2 m behind the sensor pads, >= 0.3 m ahead of the fus_rear break, >= 0.3 m above the flare ejectors and the rear hatch, 0.5 m from flaps and stabiliser along the fuselage, 30 mm or more from the centre line
faction marks (BDF 1.30 x 0.76, PALA 0.98 x 1.00 at y -4.9, z 0.24): the lower panel edge is >= 50 mm above the top of each mark box, so the mark stays on the fixed skin when the panel opens
rows.detail: lower edge z 0.8: above the mark box by {'BDF': 0.18, 'PALA': 0.06} m
